name: std-learn-derivation
description: Generic goal-directed derivation/proof-builder instrument — config-declared starting lines (facts and two-sided links) sit in a scrollable derivation panel with per-line badges, a roster of config-declared candidate steps render as buttons, and picking one dynamically matches it against the CURRENT lines (a left/right side of some link plus a same/opposite negation sense) to derive a new line, appending it with config-declared badge styling on success or surfacing a config-declared feedback string on failure; an inline clock can auto-apply the first applicable candidate every autoApplyIntervalMs while running, a Reset restores the starting lines, and the goal is reached when a derived line's label matches the config-declared goal label. Left/right and same/opposite are structural roles, not domain vocabulary, so the same matching mechanism serves propositional inference, chained implications, precursor/product chemistry, or any other two-sided-relation derivation on a biology-canvas-free text panel. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

autoApplyIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds of running clock per automatic candidate application — the 32ms base tick accumulates elapsed time and applies the first applicable candidate each time this interval elapses.
autoApplyIntervalMs.label: Auto-Apply Interval (ms)

autoRun.description: When true, INIT/MODE_SELECTED/Reset start the tick auto-applying candidates; toggle live with the Run/Pause button.
autoRun.label: Auto Run

autoRunOffMessage.description: Feedback shown when Run is toggled off (Pause).
autoRunOffMessage.label: Auto Run Off Message

autoRunOnMessage.default: Auto-stepping — tick applies the next available step.
autoRunOnMessage.description: Feedback shown when Run is toggled on.
autoRunOnMessage.label: Auto Run On Message

default.label: Forward Rule
default.noMatchFeedback: No matching premises yet for the forward rule.

default.label: Backward Rule
default.noMatchFeedback: No matching premises yet for the backward rule.

candidates.description: Candidate steps offered as buttons. Each declares which side of a link it matches against a current fact (matchSide/matchNegationMode) and which side it derives (deriveSide/deriveNegationMode) — left/right and same/opposite/invert are structural roles, not domain vocabulary, so the same two candidates can encode modus ponens/modus tollens, a forward/backward chemical rule, or any other two-sided derivation pair.
candidates.label: Candidates
candidates.synonyms: candidate, rule, step, inference rule, derivation rule, deduction rule

goalLabel.description: The line label the learner is trying to derive; goalReached fires when a newly derived line's label equals this.
goalLabel.label: Goal

goalPrefix.description: Text prepended to goalLabel to form the goal caption shown above the derivation panel.
goalPrefix.label: Goal Caption Prefix

goalReachedMessage.description: Caption shown once goalReached is true.
goalReachedMessage.label: Goal Reached Message

height.description: Maximum height of the scrollable derivation panel, in pixels.
height.label: Height

matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
matchMode.label: Match Mode

negationSymbol.description: Prefix prepended to a derived line's label when it is negated.
negationSymbol.label: Negation Symbol

noStepAvailableMessage.default: No further steps are available yet.
noStepAvailableMessage.description: Feedback shown when the auto-apply tick finds no applicable candidate.
noStepAvailableMessage.label: No Step Available Message

premises.description: The starting lines of the derivation: plain facts (subject/negated) and two-sided links (leftSubject/leftNegated/rightSubject/rightNegated) the learner combines with candidate steps. Each line carries its own badgeLabel/badgeVariant.
premises.label: Premises
premises.synonyms: premise, given, starting line, hypothesis, starting statement

resetLabel.description: Label text for the button that restores the starting premises.
resetLabel.label: Reset Button Label

title.description: Title shown above the derivation panel.
title.label: Title

width.description: Maximum width of the panel, in pixels.
width.label: Width

emits.description: The derivation state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: derivation update, proof step, derived line, candidate applied, goal reached

emits.description: Fired once when the step that derives the goal fact lands — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
emits.synonyms: round complete, finished, done, completion, goal reached

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.
events.name: Mode Selected

events.description: Learner clicked a candidate-step button to try to derive the next line: the candidate's matchSide/matchNegationMode is matched against the current lines, and on success its deriveSide/deriveNegationMode determines the appended line.
events.name: Apply Step

events.description: Learner toggled auto-derive: while running, the tick applies the first applicable candidate automatically every autoApplyIntervalMs.
events.name: Toggle Run

events.description: Learner reset the derivation: lines restore to the config-declared starting premises, feedback/narration clear, and goalReached/running reset.
events.name: Reset

events.description: The derivation state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.name: Derivation Updated
events.synonyms: derivation update, proof step, derived line, candidate applied, goal reached

events.description: Fired once when the step that derives the goal fact lands — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
events.name: Learn Round Complete
events.synonyms: round complete, finished, done, completion, goal reached
